spec2def(sxs.dll sxs.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

list(APPEND SOURCE
    # cache.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sxs-rust/src/sxs/cache.rs)
    # name.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sxs-rust/src/sxs/name.rs)
    # sxs.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sxs-rust/src/sxs/sxs.rs)
    )

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# sxs.dll is all Rust (sxs-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sxs-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# guid.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sxs-rust/src/sxs/guid.rs)
add_cargo_module(sxs sxs-cargo sxs.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE sxs-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
